items.raw_excerpt: The National Environment Agency's daily haze advisories will include the 24-hour PSI forecast to help the public plan activities and events for the next 24 hours.
items.summary_en: Singapore's National Environment Agency will now publish daily haze advisories that include a 24-hour PSI forecast. items.raw_excerpt: The infrastructure is estimated to recharge 184.59 million litres (18.459 crore litres) of rainwater annually.
items.summary_en: The Bangalore Development Authority finished 1,441 percolation wells in 77 city parks and residential areas. These wells collect rainwater and send it back into the ground to refill underground water supplies. The project should help recharge about 184 million litres each year and benefit around 82,000 residents.

items.raw_excerpt: Andhra Pradesh Cabinet sub-committee orders onions sold at ₹35/kg, seeks 1.20 lakh tonnes tur dal, subsidised palm oil and 10,000 tonnes KNM rice from Nellore to curb price rise.
